comment: The statement that weak infrastructure makes AI less likely to perform as intended is correct, but the implications vary depending on whether the AI uses local, device-generated, imaging, free-text, or national shared data.

anchor.note: p.105 l.Lines 30-31 read as the printed page; section 5.1 agrees

public.text: The statement that weak infrastructure makes AI less likely to perform as intended is correct, but the implications vary depending on whether the AI uses local, device-generated, imaging, free-text, or national shared data.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish AI use cases by their data dependency and identify the minimum infrastructure required for each category.
